note: Guidance for Organic adds no equipment; it changes the conversion schedule (README §13): role ALTERNATIVE = the phased version of the plan, parcel by parcel. It costs 0 and does not change the financed investment; it changes the margin by year and the first-year liquidity gap. phasedFirstTranchePct = share of hectares entering conversion in the first year (50 = 60 + 60 ha on a 120 ha farm); phasedDelayYears = how many years later the rest enters.

items.nameRo: Phased conversion: half of the hectares in the first year, the rest the following year
items.sourceRo: README §6, category 6, D: phasing shrinks the first-year gap but delays the gain; 50/50 is the 60 + 60 ha option for demo farm DEMO-0006
